::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 23. 1865  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS. 55384 (2): P. 964
:::

My dear Miss Yonge	
[I](people/person_939.qmd) shall be here on Wednesday from 12 till 4½ and very glad to see you. Only much regretting that your stay is to be so short.

 Yours very truly
A. Macmillan
